baseline.service: TraceMason-Service v0.1.1 Python / aiohttp / SQLite / CredentialStore
baseline.scope: 沿用Provider/API KEY/基础Ops，不重做通用网关分析

non_goals: 多用户/多租户权限体系

mode.default: off for new deployment; prototype fixture enabled
mode.forwarding: 不await审计任务、数据库或检测器；队列拥塞不回压原始转发

content.input: 所选请求内system/developer/user/assistant可识别文本；不从相似内容拼接会话
content.output: 文本增量按content index重组，正常结束/异常断流/字节预算达到后提交每方向一个任务；已审文本以字节范围记录
content.excluded: 工具JSON参数/结果、图片音视频、二进制、压缩编码无法安全解析时及WebSocket；明确unsupported/partial，不限制转发
content.coverage: full仅指配置范围内文本完整；未覆盖工具或二进制必须随coverage_reason列出；partial无命中只显示已审片段未发现风险
content.finalize: 唯一(request_id,direction,attempt)；流结束只提交一次；无文本skipped；HTTP>=400不把错误页当模型输出

detection.model: 自由字符串，不依据名称推断能力

categories.harmful: 有害内容；具体子类别由适配器映射

detection.result: 必须含decision、findings；findings含category/severity/quote/start/end；证据区间匹配受检文本；未知类别保留unknown_categories；出现未知结论或枚举invalid_detector_result；未完成类别不能生成完整clear
detection.json_protocol: /chat/completions，消息将被审文本作为不可信数据；返回JSON对象；校验schema与证据，不接受任意散文或模型自报成功
detection.qwen3guard: 专用解析器将安全等级与风险类别映射，不能提供逐字证据时evidence_state=not_provided；禁止编造引用；通过固定语料与输出样本验证后启用
detection.retry: 不自动重试检测HTTP；人工重审建立新事件
detection.scope_notice: 所选文本会发送至用户配置的检测端点；内容不得写入普通日志；本轮原型无网络调用

events.key: UUID/ULID + monotonic sequence for delete snapshot

review.reason: 1..500 trimmed characters; no content snippets in operation log
review.actor: existing trusted-local administrator identity; not multiuser authentication
review.false_positive: 人工标注独立于detector decision；不自动改变规则或训练模型
review.reason_storage: 复核说明加密留存，跟随content_expires_at；过期只保留复核枚举/操作者/时间，不返回说明正文

reaudit.requires: 当前启用且账号方向在范围；留存内容尚未过期；只重审脱敏片段
reaudit.parent: parent_id/request_id/direction retained; latest config snapshot; attempts unique transactionally
reaudit.coverage: partial/redacted_snapshot; result does not represent original text
reaudit.retention: child content expiry never exceeds source content expiry

config.CAS: expected_revision in PUT;409 conflict; reload cannot silently overwrite
config.secrets: write-only replace, empty retains; no API echoes; credentials frozen by versioned secret reference retained while jobs use it
config.activation: commit then atomic snapshot; runtime exposes expected_revision/active_revision/load_error; failed load keeps last valid config, disables new audits on cold-start failure
config.validation: at least1 account/direction/category when enabled; content_days<=metadata_days; HTTP(S) URL with no embedded credentials/query/fragment; deny redirect; outbound user-selected private/local detectors permitted only explicitly configured, no user request may choose target

storage.database: separate audit.sqlite WAL; serialized writer off relay event loop; dedicated persistent volume audit-data
storage.encryption: AES-GCM with dedicated audit content key derived separately from credential key; AAD event_id+policy_revision+payload_kind; key file0600, separate volume; no plaintext body in SQLite/logs/backups
storage.temporary: pre-redaction detector text encrypted TTL <=30min; deleted on terminal outcome; chosen detector receives necessary content; no blanket claim that all secrets can be recognized
storage.retained: redact body and evidence together; default7d; evidence spans refer to retained safe content or evidence unavailable; credentials excluded structurally; PII redaction occurs after detector inspection
storage.metadata: default30d; cascade content/findings/reviews/jobs/payload; operation metadata default90d no content
storage.expire: GET checks expires_at synchronously; cleanup worker every60s; policy shortening min(old_expiry,created_at+new_days); extension only new events; expired cannot resurrect

queue.admission: bounded dispatcher nonblocking; separate durable capacity transaction; no acknowledged durable job until encrypted payload+job+event atomically commit
queue.dropped: count instance/process epoch and reason, never invent per-request record when admission failed; existing affected records partial
queue.lease: claim pending atomically; heartbeat; lease60s; expired running becomes failed/interrupted on startup, no automatic duplicate detector call
queue.restart: unexpired pending with payload resumes; stale running fails; temporary TTL expired fails payload_expired; in-memory uncommitted losses cannot be recovered
queue.shutdown: stop new audit admissions; bounded5s flush; forwarding shutdown follows existing service policy
queue.database_failure: mark runtime degraded and stop admission; after successful health probe accept new jobs; never fabricate lost history
queue.attribution: detector availability and audit health separate from upstream request outcome

auth.reuse: existing loopback Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site boundary and GET /api/session token bootstrap
auth.audit_routes: X-TraceMason-Token required on ALL audit APIs including content GET; server-side check; browser fixture does not implement auth
auth.deployment: trusted local administration only; container management port binds loopback; remote/multiuser exposure requires separate authentication design
auth.body: 4KiB metadata defaults; config/probe sample max1MiB; JSON only writes; logs no credentials/content

query.summary: same normalized predicate as list; counts by direction event, not request count; dropped counter excluded from denominator
query.pagination: page>=1,page_size1..100 default20, created_at DESC,id DESC; total scoped
query.export: same predicate, metadata only, maximum10000 rows and20MiB;413 if exceeded; no content/review reason/evidence

delete.preview: filtered terminal events only; pending/running excluded; fixed id snapshot max10000; normalized filter hash+actor+config_revision+snapshot ids+expiry60s; single-use server token
delete.confirm: transaction consume token and delete same IDs;409 stale config,410 expired;403 wrong actor; added events never included; return actual deleted_count
delete.retention: same cascade; operation log retains action/count/id references without content

prototype.storage: synthetic fixture data only in localStorage tm-content-audit-v012-r6; never store typed API keys
limitations: no durable workers or actual fault injection
local fixture export/deletion do not affect production
检测服务检查仅演示校验流程，不证明真实端点连通；样例输入仅做示例脱敏，不能提供真实敏感数据保障
prototype.review_scope: flows and state labels only; backend correctness requires production_gate acceptance cases
